periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree downward tilt relative to the horizontal facial axis, oriented towards the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a high aspect ratio, where the primary diagonal axis is approximately 1.5 times the width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering towards the lower mandible, creating a teardrop-shaped lower margin.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Wide, relatively flat U-shape profile at the posterior margin as it crosses the dorsal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band occupies approximately 30-35% of the visible torso length between the neck and the hindquarters.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The inter-ear gap is approximately equivalent to the base width of a single ear structure.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Highly rounded and convex curvature at the superior boundaries.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct clumped texture in the white pelage on the posterior lumbar and hip region.
